svg.title: Paddlewheel aerator — Spaðaloftari
svg.desc: A surface paddlewheel has four rectangular peripheral paddles, an axle and a side motor above waves.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"aquaculture-paddlewheel-aerator","label_en":"Paddlewheel aerator","label_is":"Spaðaloftari","section":"02","category_en":"Aquaculture and seafood processing","category_is":"Fiskeldi og fiskvinnsla","batch":1,"tags":["aquaculture","aeration"],"description":"A surface paddlewheel has four rectangular peripheral paddles, an axle and a side motor above waves.","design_note":"Four actual rectangular paddles at the wheel rim, linked by short spokes to its rim and hub, prevent a sun-like silhouette while showing surface aeration.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
